subject: Fix XXH_STATIC_ASSERT to avoid possible stack allocation
perf_evidence: Commit replaces the pre-C11 array-based static assertion that could allocate stack space.
change_summary: Changes the C99 XXH_STATIC_ASSERT fallback from a local array declaration to a function declaration.

units.name: public canonical conversion and XXH3 fixed long inputs in C99 scalar mode
units.evidence: Five public scalar C99 targets pass Alive2 in both directions.

units.name: C99 AVX2/low-optimization paths containing the changed assertion macro
units.evidence: The retained -O0 run encounters unsupported noalias attributes in long-path bodies; the AVX2 run also fails Alive2 translation before proving public targets.

notes: The macro's compile-time behavior differs, while the checked C99 scalar output paths agree. Some vector/low-optimization IR remains untranslatable by this Alive2 build.
